corpus_overview.warning: Evidence below uses heterogeneous cohorts; this overview is not the denominator for every result.

router_quantization.scope: six canonical caches; see cache_inventory.csv, including caches outside the five-task K32 candidate cohort
router_quantization.estimand: identifiability of logged TopK and hypothetical output-rounding sensitivity, not historical fp32 truth

candidate_query0.scope: five tasks, 80 task-by-init pools, 32 seeds per pool, 2560 candidates at query 0
candidate_query0.cached_state_check: simulator and proprio states bit-identical within pool; RGB unavailable
candidate_query0.selection: all complete K32 pools for action/response; final success uses only 40 retrospectively outcome-mixed pools across four tasks
candidate_query0.estimand: transductive ranking within an observed complete K32 pool
candidate_query0.uncertainty_scope: cluster resampling of frozen OOF predictions; no model refit per bootstrap

state_concept_matrix.scope: 51308 queries, 2560 rollouts, five tasks, 80 task-by-init clusters
state_concept_matrix.limits: exploratory, no multiplicity correction, five tasks, linear geometry baseline, observational readout

q0_plus_8_full_cached_state.scope: long/SCENE8 only, clean-444 cohort, one q0+8 landmark cut, 16 init states, L2-logistic model family
q0_plus_8_full_cached_state.selection: stagnation-core or active-return failure versus success at first-pot2-goal-proxy plus eight queries
q0_plus_8_full_cached_state.uncertainty_scope: init-cluster resampling of frozen OOF predictions; no model refit per bootstrap

t34.scope: long/SCENE8 only, 512 rollouts active at absolute query 34, 16 init states
t34.estimand: concurrent state decodability only; phase-matched early warning risk-set gate fails

post_error_adaptation.scope: natural cached rollout event inventory across task/event/threshold/outcome definitions
post_error_adaptation.decision_basis: true setbacks lack recovery successes; high-support landmarks are normal task motion

legacy_trajectory_clustering.scope: 2560-rollout five-task corpus with success-terminated and failure-at-cap episodes
legacy_trajectory_clustering.decision_basis: episode length/timeout sentinel reproduces or exceeds the reported failure blocks

fresh_capture_required: same-hidden fp32 shadow logits and probabilities
controlled checkpoint setbacks and shared continuation seeds
dense substep state, contact/grasp truth, RGB or vision embeddings
